answer: Artifact filing: each identity files one saffron-sealed work artifact in a trellis registry and stakes 70 credits. Each epoch a pulse audit re-checks the filed hash and needs fresh key-signed proof; a copied artifact under two keys, or a rented one, fails and burns the bond. A farm minting 1,000 fake identities spends 1,000 x (45 fee + 70 bond) = 115,000 chasing a 40,000 pool. One honest filing costs 45 once and the bond stays refundable.
